reason: Manoah (מָנוֹחַ) is an explicitly named character introduced as 'a man from Zorah from the family of the Danites.' He is portrayed as an ordinary Israelite with no superhuman powers or special divine status (unlike his son Samson, who is a Nazirite with divine strength). Manoah is depicted as a regular person—concerned with family matters, praying to God, and seeking guidance about raising his son. He represents the class of typical human characters in the narrative.
